caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall vase with a bulbous base and a long, narrow neck that widens into a ruffled, flared rim at the top. The vase is predominantly light blue in color with a glossy appearance. It features a decorative pattern consisting of stylized flowers and leaves along the vertical axis of the body. The flowers are composed of red circular centers with radiating red and purple petals, while the leaves are elongated and colored in shades of green and yellow. The floral motifs are arranged in symmetrical clusters on the upper and lower parts of the vase's body. The vase stands alone against an off-white background with no additional objects, appearing centered and clearly delineated.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
